summary.text: Timmy French is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia, representing District 1, serving since 2024.
The district covers all of Clarke, Frederick, Shenandoah and Warren counties and Winchester City.
The Senate biography lists Timmy French's occupation as farmer and co-owner of French Brothers Dairy, Springdale Poultry and Springdale Family Farms.

paragraphs.text: The biography says Timmy French was born in Woodstock, Virginia.
It lists Central High School and an American FFA degree (1988) under education.
The memberships entry lists past service on the Shenandoah County Agricultural and Forestal District Advisory Committee and as past president of the Shenandoah County Farm Bureau.
Timmy French serves on the Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources; General Laws and Technology; and Rehabilitation and Social Services committees.
